scope: Development review notes, not final exact-version acceptance
source_status: uncommitted implementation under review; final receipt will bind exact commit
inputs: Only repository-generated synthetic documents and packages; no personal library content

findings.problem: Splitting Markdown removed reference-style link definitions from independently rendered blocks.
findings.repair: Preserve the definitions used by each block, including nested blockquote and list references.
findings.verification: Parser unit tests render each resulting block with MarkdownIt.

findings.problem: Signature-at-start detection could misclassify prefixed archives as learner-readable originals.
findings.repair: Stage detected archives privately regardless of filename or selected textual kind; reject format mismatch and unclaimed archive bytes.
findings.verification: Real import repository tests cover SFX prefix, misleading extension and explicit text-kind spoof.

findings.problem: Author ZIP plus learner ZIP was accepted by standard ZIP readers as the final learner archive, exposing the earlier private original bytes.
findings.repair: Require complete archive envelope coverage, rejecting prefixes, concatenation, tails, gaps, comments and extra container data.

findings.problem: An author archive hidden after a valid DEFLATE stream still fit the declared ZIP envelope. Standard ZipFile returned only the public decoded member.
findings.repair: Require full compressed stream consumption, eof, no unused/unconsumed bytes, matching local/central metadata and size/CRC.

findings.problem: Parser, publication, manifest and browser limits prevented explicit budget expansion required by section 10.1.
findings.repair: Five validated budgets, frozen import input, configured manifest resource fields and server-authoritative upload validation. Existing content remains readable after lowering future-import limits.
findings.verification: Parser budget regression, test_import_budgets.py, real HTTP 400000-character expansion and repository restart/configuration regression.

findings.problem: A pre-switch preview response or downloaded Blob could arrive after changing to learner role.
findings.repair: Invalidate task/draft access generations on role change, revoke Blob URLs, and discard responses from the previous permission epoch.
findings.verification: Native browser holds real author preview and artifact responses, changes role, releases responses and asserts no private projection or download.

findings.problem: A learner permitted to cancel a pending archive could receive 403 when replaying or reading the resulting cancellation.
findings.repair: Provide minimal terminal status without private preview data; preserve source/draft denial.

findings.problem: Appending a package to another course left Symbol.scope referring to the unpublished source course ID.
findings.repair: Apply target-course mapping to the symbol scope as well as its exact definition reference.

findings.problem: The encoding error was explicit but offered no encoding-choice preview required by section20.3.
findings.repair: Strict local decoding of hash-verified original, explicit UTF-8 derivative download, separate import confirmation; original failed record and raw hash preserved.
findings.verification: encoding.test.ts and native local-encoding derivative/reimport test on final commit; original failed state/hash unchanged.

findings.problem: After awaiting real lazy body rendering, the narrow-screen header/close control can still be clipped while scrolling. An earlier loading-state capture obscured this remaining defect.
findings.repair: Inspect actual nested scroll geometry and fix the dialog scroll container; test real visibility without resetting scroll position for the screenshot.
findings.verification: Frontend browser diagnosis in progress; existing27 functional tests alone did not prove this manual visual condition.
findings.diagnosis: Native old CSS geometry reproduced simultaneous dialog/inner scrolling; fixed CSS makes only workflow body scroll, leaving dialog and inner scrollTop zero and header above the body.

development_test_failures.description: First native attempt used an exact import-button label that omitted its keyboard hint; four tests failed before uploading.
Second native attempt expected one SVG while the candidate legitimately contained two formula SVGs; three tests passed.
First author-package browser fixture attempted to serialize a list as a single Pydantic model and failed before upload.
Initial HTTP assertions assumed the first block contained the paragraph/formula, but headings are independent blocks. Tests now select the relevant candidate and scan all bodies for unsafe content.
A reload test sent a keyboard shortcut before React installed its listener; now it waits for the real workspace session to be ready. Six other native cases passed in that run.

First exact gate passed all27 browser tests, but its390px screenshot captured the lazy-body loading state. Strengthened test waits for actual paragraph before security assertions and capture. Original exact receipts remain preserved.

The first new close-button hit test sampled1px from rounded corners, outside the actual curved button. Retained the failure and corrected sampling to center and four inset axis points; this was not evidence of actual button occlusion.

final_verification: All seven exact-version gates passed: Python402, frontend49, native27, lint/types/build/spec.
